name: CookiePilot
author: mlemiesz

sections.description:
CookiePilot is a comprehensive Consent Management Platform (CMP) that helps you comply with GDPR, ePrivacy, and other privacy regulations. Manage cookie consent banners across all your websites from one central dashboard.

Key Features

  • Visual Banner Editor – Customize colors, texts, and layout without coding
  • Google Consent Mode v2 – Full compliance with Google’s requirements
  • Multiple Languages – Support for Polish and English out of the box
  • Script Blocking – Automatically block tracking scripts until consent
  • Agency Mode – Generate installation codes for client websites
  • Stripe Integration – Manage subscriptions directly from WordPress
  • Analytics – Track consent rates and user interactions

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Create a CookiePilot account or use an agency code
  3. Customize your cookie banner
  4. The banner automatically appears on your website

Agency Mode

Web agencies can generate one-time installation codes for their clients:

  1. Agency creates token in CookiePilot dashboard
  2. Client installs plugin and enters the code
  3. Domain is automatically linked to agency account
  4. Agency manages all client domains from one place

Cookie Categories

  • Necessary – Essential for website functionality (always enabled)
  • Analytics – Usage tracking (Google Analytics, etc.)
  • Marketing – Advertising and retargeting
  • Preferences – User customization settings

Supported Trackers

CookiePilot automatically detects and manages:

  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Tag Manager
  • Facebook Pixel
  • LinkedIn Insight
  • Hotjar, Mixpanel
  • And 50+ more…

External Services

This plugin connects to the CookiePilot API to provide cookie consent management functionality.

What data is sent and when

  • Domain registration: When you add your domain, the site URL is sent to create your consent banner configuration
  • Banner configuration: The plugin fetches your customized banner settings (colors, texts, layout) from the API
  • Consent records: When visitors interact with the cookie banner, their consent choices are sent to the API for compliance record-keeping
  • Pageview counting: Anonymous pageview counts are sent to track usage against your plan limits

Service Details

This service is provided by CookiePilot.

  • Service URL: https://api.cookiepilot.io
  • Website: https://cookiepilot.io
  • Terms of Service: https://cookiepilot.io/regulamin
  • Privacy Policy: https://cookiepilot.io/polityka-prywatnosci

The plugin requires an active connection to the CookiePilot API to function. Without it, the consent banner cannot be displayed or configured.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “CookiePilot”
  3. Click Install and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to CookiePilot in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Create an account or log in
  3. Click “Add this domain” to connect your website
  4. Customize your banner appearance
  5. Save and your banner is live!
sections.faq:
Is CookiePilot free?

CookiePilot offers a free plan with 1 domain and 10,000 pageviews/month. Paid plans are available for more domains and features.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes, CookiePilot works with all major caching plugins including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, and LiteSpeed Cache.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes, CookiePilot is designed for full GDPR, ePrivacy, and CCPA compliance. It blocks tracking scripts until the user gives consent.

What is Google Consent Mode v2?

Google Consent Mode v2 is Google’s framework for communicating user consent choices to Google services. CookiePilot automatically integrates with it.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes, with paid plans you can manage multiple domains from one account. Agencies can use installation codes for unlimited client sites.

What happens if the API is down?

The consent banner is cached locally. If the API is temporarily unavailable, your banner will continue to work.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release
  • User registration and login from WordPress admin
  • Full visual banner editor with live preview
  • Visual Effects: Glassmorphism, Floating Card 3D, Gradient Accents
  • Entry animations: Slide Up, Slide Down, Fade
  • Toggle animations: Spring, Smooth
  • Consent button for re-opening settings
  • Agency mode with one-time installation tokens
  • Stripe payment integration
  • Google Consent Mode v2 support
  • Automatic script blocking for 50+ trackers
  • Multi-language support (Polish, English)
  • Pageview usage tracking and limits display
